Estruturar e consolidar um portfólio de produtos competitivo, inovador e orientado ao cliente, fortalecendo o posicionamento da Vibra no mercado. Integrar visão de negócio, tecnologia, dados e experiência do cliente para maximizar geração de valor e vantagem competitiva.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Vivência em transformação digital e em ambientes corporativos de grande porte e alta complexidade.
  • Sólida capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e orientação a dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência na liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento consistente de metodologias ágeis, gestão de produtos, discovery e frameworks de priorização.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Promover e preservar a saúde dos colaboradores no ambiente de trabalho, por meio de ações de medicina preventiva, assistencial e ocupacional, conforme a legislação vigente e as normas da empresa.

Realizar exames médicos admissionais, periódicos, de retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissionais conforme exigências da NR-7 (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional – PCMSO);

Elaborar, coordenar e implementar o PCMSO;

Avaliar as condições de saúde dos colaboradores, identificando fatores de risco ocupacional;

Emitir e controlar atestados de saúde ocupacional (ASO);

Participar de programas de qualidade de vida e prevenção de doenças no ambiente de trabalho;

Analisar e acompanhar afastamentos médicos, atuando junto ao INSS e à perícia médica quando necessário;

Assessorar tecnicamente os setores da empresa quanto às ações de promoção e vigilância em saúde;

Apoiar a CIPA e demais comissões internas de saúde e segurança;

Trabalhar em conjunto com o Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho na identificação e mitigação de riscos à saúde;

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação completa em Medicina;

Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho (com título de especialista reconhecido pelo CRM);

Registro ativo no CRM;

Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e normas regulamentadoras;

Habilidades em comunicação, ética, sigilo e trabalho em equipe.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Informações adicionais

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 30h semanais

Horário: a combinar

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development.

You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To succeed in this role, you typically have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, you will find:

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

  • You have experience supporting non‑technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution contexts.
  • You’ve built or refined internal support workflows, macros, or dashboards.

Why Join Canals

  • Real‑world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.
  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.
  • Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first.
  • Remote‑first, flexible work environment across North and South America.
  • Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love.
  • All‑star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from.

title: Human Rights Manager
description:
Department

Social Responsibility & Education

Location

Brazil

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone.
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms.
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities.
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.
  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes.
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidate Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations.
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events.
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition.
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards.
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem, no setor de Nefrologia/Hemodiálise, e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Realizar orientações aos pacientes;
  • Manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis;
  • Orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e equipe multiprofissional;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Qualificações e Condições

  • Nível superior completo em enfermagem.
  • Registro ativo e regular com anuidade paga no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN-RJ).
  • Comprovação, por meio de certificado, de especialização na área de atuação.
  • Comprovação de, no mínimo, 6 meses de experiência atuando como enfermeiro na área de atuação (Hemodiálise).
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x60 ainda a serem definidas.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

title: PRODUCT OWNER
description:
Sobre a Vaga


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner com perfil estratégico e relacional para liderar a evolução de produtos e soluções voltadas para o segmento de órgãos institucionais, com foco especial em demandas técnicas do DETRAN. O PO será responsável por traduzir necessidades complexas do cliente em requisitos claros, gerenciar o backlog de produto e garantir a entrega de valor contínuo.


A posição combina análise técnica profunda, relacionamento estratégico com stakeholders (DETRAN, despachantes, entidades e parceiros público-privado) e gestão ágil de produto, com atuação tanto remota quanto em campo para melhor compreensão das demandas.


Principais responsabilidades



  • Elicitar, analisar e documentar requisitos técnicos e funcionais, especialmente de demandas complexas do DETRAN e órgãos institucionais.

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de produto, alinhando com objetivos estratégicos e necessidades do cliente.

  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas (desenvolvimento, arquitetura) e stakeholders (DETRAN, clientes, parceiros), garantindo alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Conduzir reuniões de refinamento, validação e aceite de requisitos com foco em clareza e viabilidade técnica.

  • Acompanhar e validar entregas, garantindo conformidade com requisitos e padrões de qualidade.

  • Participar ativamente em campo, com visitas a clientes e órgãos para melhor compreensão do contexto operacional e demandas técnicas.

  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com DETRAN e demais stakeholders, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

  • Preparar e acompanhar indicadores de produto (ex.: adoção, satisfação, impacto técnico, ROI).

  • Participar de reuniões internas e alinhar ações com áreas envolvidas (desenvolvimento, operações, comercial, suporte).

  • Documentar decisões, trade-offs e aprendizados para manutenção de histórico e conhecimento institucional.


Requisitos



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em papel similar (mínimo 2-3 anos).

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro ou similar).

  • Forte capacidade de análise técnica e compreensão de arquitetura de software, APIs e integrações.

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes institucionais, órgãos públicos ou ambientes regulados é um diferencial.

  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e capacidade de conduzir conversas complexas com diferentes perfis técnicos e não-técnicos.

  • Organização para documentação, rastreamento de requisitos e gestão de prioridades.

  • Conforto com rotina híbrida: remoto + campo (visitas e agendas presenciais).

  • Conhecimento em domínios como DETRAN, trânsito, licitações ou parcerias público-privada é um diferencial.


Desejável



  • Conhecimento estruturado em governança de TI baseado em COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies), incluindo governança e gestão orientada a valor, gestão de riscos, compliance, controles e alinhamento estratégico entre negócio e tecnologia.

  • Domínio prático de frameworks ágeis, especialmente Scrum, incluindo gestão de backlog, sprint planning, review, retrospectiva, escrita de user stories, critérios de aceite e priorização por valor.

  • Conhecimento ou certificação em PMP (Project Management Professional), com entendimento do ecossistema de gestão de projetos, incluindo PMBOK, gestão de escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, riscos e stakeholders.

  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes híbridos de gestão (ágil + tradicional), conectando produto, projeto e governança.

  • Conhecimento complementar desejável: ITIL, Lean, Lean Inception, Design Thinking, Product Discovery e Delivery, OKRs e métricas de produto.


Perfil



  • Estratégico e orientado a valor/resultado

  • Relacional e comunicativo, com capacidade de influência

  • Ágil e adaptável a mudanças

  • Organizado(a), disciplinado(a) e orientado(a) a indicadores

  • Proativo(a) e altamente comprometido(a)

  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that, for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Communications

Location

Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)

Position

The Junior Graphic Designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil, will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will support the creative development of brand assets, ensuring consistent, world‑class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America, with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world‑class graphic design excellence, strong project‑management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in sports and entertainment. It reports to the Global Head of Brand, Marketing & Promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports the creative process from concept to execution across channels, ensuring high‑quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs and produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develops key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital‑first creative assets.
  • Ensures strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic design experience in brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High‑level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

Your Profile

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven hands‑on expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large‑scale brand projects and live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word, PowerPoint, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports‑related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistência estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

  • Preparar e administrar medicações por via oral, tópica, intradérmica, subcutânea, intramuscular, endovenosa e retal, segundo prescrição médica, sob supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Receber e passar o plantão mantendo adequada comunicação entre as equipes;
  • Realizar o arquivo dos registros de enfermagem, conforme orientação do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem e Enfermeiro;
  • Interagir com os diversos processos e serviços da unidade;

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Senior Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
About us

Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.

About the role

You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders.

You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.
  • Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS).
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk‑based and scalable way.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  • Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.
  • Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.
  • Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward‑looking, data‑driven insights to senior management and Committees.
  • Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.

Qualification Requirements

  • Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI‑DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.
  • Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.
  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.
  • Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.
  • Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) required.

Nice to have Requirements

  • Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.

International experience is highly desirable.

Sr Staff Software Engineer - CC Core Platforms

About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. The Company is preparing for its next growth cycle where it will accelerate its internationalization process outside Latin America, and will also enter new verticals beyond financial services in its core markets taking advantage of the significant customer penetration.

About the role We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical evolution of our Credit Card platform. This is not a traditional maintenance role. You will be the architect of a profound transformation: leveraging Generative AI to automate complex operational tasks and orchestrating the global migration from our current systems to a unified, future-proof architecture. You will be a key partner to the Engineering Leadership and a reference for the entire engineering community.

Mission Your goal is to design and operationalize a technical strategy that uses AI to increase operational efficiency while accelerating our global migration, ensuring:

  • Intelligent Maintenance: Implementing AI agents to analyze tickets and crashes, automating resolutions for the global credit card environment.
  • Seamless Migration: Leading the coexistence strategy between legacy and new platforms across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring data integrity and a flawless customer experience.
  • Technical Excellence: Solving deep architectural bottlenecks in high-scale distributed systems and raising the bar for software design globally.

Core Responsibilities

  • Migration Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap for decommissioning legacy systems, starting with the 1-year migration plan for the Colombian market.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Architect and integrate AI solutions (cloud-based agents) to automate infrastructure maintenance and data migration.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with General Managers, PMs, and Staff+ ICs to align technical decisions with business needs across different countries.
  • Mentorship & Culture: Mentor senior engineers, fostering a culture of pragmatism, excellence in distributed systems, and the adoption of cutting-edge AI tools.
  • Navigating Complexity: You will work on high-scale systems supporting millions of transactions where every decision impacts customer limits and billing.
  • Modernizing the Core: You have the unique opportunity to make "legacy" systems attractive and efficient by applying AI to remove heavy operational toil.

Core Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

  • Proven Track Record: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on large-scale distributed systems.
  • Migration Mastery: Proven experience leading critical system migrations and managing coexistence between old and new architectures.
  • AI Fluency: A strong interest or practical experience in using GenAI/LLMs to solve engineering productivity and data analysis challenges.
  • Platform Mindset: Ability to design reusable APIs and contracts that serve multiple product teams with high reliability.
  • Global Communication: Fluent English is required to collaborate across our global hubs (Brazil, US, Mexico, and Colombia).

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

title: Brazil Hull Plan Approval Engineer
description:
Mission

This role focuses on performing detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and approve hull structural drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to structural design.
  • Resolve issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards.
  • Perform assessments and provide specialist advice for service delivery, research or development work within agreed broad parameters that include budget constraints and contractual requirements.
  • Oversee and manage day-to-day project elements, visit sites to take measurements.
  • Ensure correct and up-to-date data is used and complete documentation is submitted to officials and other day-to-day duties.
  • Review the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc).
  • Review progress reports and take appropriate action to ensure requirements are met.
  • Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks.
  • Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues.
  • Manage simple and complex projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Assess complex structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions.
  • Answer complex contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering

Qualifications

Experience

  • Experience in hull design, shipbuilding, or marine engineering, with a focus on plan approval in a Class Society or shipbuilding environment.
  • Experience in the review and approval of hull structural designs, stability calculations, and material selection, ensuring compliance with applicable rules and regulations.
  • Practical experience working with international maritime standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, etc.) and Class Society regulations.
  • In-depth experience in the hull plan approval process, including structural integrity verification, load distribution, and strength calculations.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced understanding of ship hull design principles, structural components, and materials used in hull construction.
  • Expertise in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and stability calculations for hull structures to ensure compliance with design codes and Class Society standards.
  • Proficiency in software tools commonly used in hull plan approval and structural analysis, such as AutoCAD, NAPA, ShipConstructor, or other naval architecture and engineering software.
  • In-depth knowledge of materials used in hull construction, including steel grades, welding techniques, and corrosion protection methods.

Additional Information

  • Office located in Centro (RJ).
  • Hybrid work regime (after first period 100% on site).
  • All of our positions are also available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD).

  • FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.
  • PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
  • INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
  • DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Brazil Stability Plan Approval Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the Latin America Marine Division.

Mission

This role focuses on supporting the elaboration of detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and approve loadline assignments, intact & damage stability booklets, loading computer and ballast water management plan, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to load line, stability, loading computer and ballast water management plan matters.
  • Provide support for the elaboration of detailed marine engineering plan review, in compliance with applicable RINA rules, international conventions and contractual requirements.
  • Provide support for the resolution of issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards.
  • Provide direct day-to-day support and oversight of project elements, visit sites to take measurements.
  • Provide direct or indirect support to engineers or engineering teams by gathering data, submitting documentation to officials and other day-to-day duties.
  • Prepare the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc.).
  • Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks.
  • Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues.
  • Manage simple projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Assess minor structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Answer contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General

Qualifications

  • Experience in ship stability analysis, preferably within a class society, shipbuilding, or maritime consultancy.
  • In-depth knowledge of stability regulations, including IMO codes, classification society rules, and international maritime safety conventions related to ship stability.
  • Expertise in stability calculations, including intact stability, damage stability, and parametric rolling analysis, using hydrodynamic software and engineering tools.
  • Proficiency in interpreting and approving stability plans, ensuring ships meet regulatory requirements and classification standards.
  • Experience in evaluating stability conditions for both new builds and retrofit projects, with the ability to suggest improvements or modifications when necessary.
  • Strong understanding of ship design and how structural elements (e.g., cargo holds, ballast systems) affect overall stability.
  • Ability to collaborate with design teams, surveyors, and shipbuilders to ensure the correct implementation of stability plans.
  • Familiarity with ship operational parameters and understanding how stability is impacted by various operational scenarios, including ballast water management and loading/unloading procedures.
  • Strong communication and reporting skills for producing clear and concise stability assessment reports for clients and stakeholders.

Additional Information

  • Office located in Centro (RJ).
  • Hybrid work regime (after first period 100% on site).
  • All of our positions are also available to people with disabilities (PwD/PCD).

Um vendedor de loja desempenha um papel crucial em garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência de compra satisfatória e eficiente.

As principais responsabilidades de um vendedor incluem:

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

Vita Check-up

Sobre a vaga: Buscamos uma Técnica de Patologia qualificada, dedicada e com boa comunicação para integrar nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Você será responsável por promover o encantamento do cliente por meio da condução segura, humanizada e eficiente dos processos de assistência, coleta de exames laboratoriais, preparo e envio de amostras, avaliações de bioimpedância e demais procedimentos de preparo para o check‑up. Atuar na prevenção e solução de intercorrências, assegurando excelência na experiência do cliente, mantendo a liderança informada e solicitando providências quando necessário. Prestar assistência às necessidades básicas dos clientes (higiene, conforto e apoio emocional), zelando continuamente por sua segurança e bem‑estício durante toda a jornada no serviço.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar coleta de exames laboratoriais, incluindo punção venosa para coleta de sangue, seguindo protocolos técnicos e de biossegurança.
  • Executar avaliações de bioimpedância e outros procedimentos de preparo dos clientes para exames.
  • Preparar amostras biológicas para envio à análise técnica, incluindo identificação, centrifugação, acondicionamento, armazenamento e rastreabilidade.
  • Cadastrar informações de exames nos sistemas laboratoriais, de imagem e demais avaliações, garantindo fluxo ágil e seguro de atendimento.
  • Acompanhar e prestar apoio aos clientes durante a realização do check‑up, oferecendo orientações e suporte sempre que necessário.
  • Organizar salas de atendimento, conferindo formulários, equipamentos e materiais, inclusive controle de validade.
  • Avaliar necessidade de materiais permanentes (ex.: braçadeira de PNI, cabos, sensores) e descartáveis, solicitando reposição e preenchendo check‑lists.
  • Executar limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de equipamentos e superfícies, conforme protocolos institucionais.
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos equipamentos, comunicando anormalidades à liderança imediata.
  • Cumprir estratégias e diretrizes da Diretoria, participando de reuniões e rituais de gestão quando solicitado.

Competências funcionais e técnicas

  • Conhecimento e experiência em coleta de sangue e demais exames laboratoriais.
  • Domínio dos processos de preparo de amostras biológicas (centrifugação, identificação, acondicionamento e envio).
  • Conhecimento de biossegurança e uso adequado de EPIs conforme NR‑32.
  • Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde.
  • Capacidade de registro correto de informações em sistemas.
  • Capacidade de se expressar corretamente verbal e na escrita.

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação e capacidade para lidar com conflitos: Habilidade de construir e manter relacionamentos dentro e fora do setor Operacional. Clareza oral e escrita, capacidade de expressar suas ideias. Capacidade para ouvir e entender a necessidade dos clientes externos e internos das demais áreas do negócio.
  • Iniciativa: proatividade para identificar riscos e propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Trabalho em equipe: trabalha cooperativamente, integrando pessoas e gerando uma ambiência de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo.
  • Adaptação à mudança: entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades, direcionamentos e conjuntura. Flexibilidade para mudança de acordo com o ambiente. Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Análises Clínicas, Patologia Clínica, Laboratório ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em informática básica.

title: Technical Implementations Specialist
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the “Last Mile” problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

This Involves

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.
  • Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files.
  • Navigating complex data mapping requirements.
  • Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures.
  • Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines.
  • Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap.
  • Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications.
  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

About You

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.
  • Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage.
  • Agile Delivery Lead. You are comfortable leading a specialized technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in client‑required formats while maintaining alignment with strict delivery roadmaps and deadlines.
  • Operational Driver. You are familiar with tools like Jira and Confluence, using them to govern the full development lifecycle, prioritize backlogs, document technical specs, and facilitate daily stand‑ups to remove blockers.
  • Quality : You take a hands‑on approach to Internal QA, ensuring 100% accuracy against signed‑off specifications before any data is delivered to a stakeholder.
  • First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets.
  • 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out on‑site seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floor plans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology‑minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Nossas equipes de logística estão transformando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo, resolvendo diariamente alguns dos maiores desafios do setor — não apenas para a Amazon, mas para toda a indústria. Seja transportando itens grandes ou pequenos, buscamos soluções inovadoras para garantir que nossa promessa ao cliente seja sempre cumprida.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está em busca de um(a) Especialista de Operações Logísticas para integrar o time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), responsável pelas estações de entrega operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa atuará em nível estratégico, executando todas as funções de Torre de Controle e, além disso, liderando iniciativas de otimização e melhoria contínua das operações.

As atividades ocorrem 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados, e os especialistas seguem uma escala 4x3, divididos entre equipes front e back. O ambiente de trabalho é altamente colaborativo e dinâmico, com uma mentalidade de testar e experimentar novas ideias.

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento dos parceiros de entrega, propondo melhorias de processo constantemente

  • Analisar dados de múltiplas fontes identificando tendências para decisões estratégicas, avaliando eficácia do planejamento de rotas
  • Desenvolver soluções estruturantes para desvios operacionais com medidas preventivas
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento diárias e semanais com parceiros e áreas internas
  • Investigar causas raízes dos problemas operacionais através de análises detalhadas, estabelecendo planos de ação para indicadores abaixo da meta
  • Realizar controle de inventário, fechamento de operação e coordenar análise de desvios recorrentes (não entregues, extraviados, perdidos)

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
  • Experience with Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree

title: Operations Intern
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Fixed Term

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

About Yinson

Yinson is a leading global integrated offshore production company committed to fostering innovation and sustainability. We pride ourselves on a culture that values teamwork, excellence, and proactive problem‑solving, ensuring that every team member contributes to a sustainable future. Our vision is to become a world‑class provider of integrated energy solutions, and your role as an intern will play a significant part in this journey.

Core Responsibilities

  • Assist the Onshore Team in monitoring and controlling daily operations, ensuring compliance with company standards and contributing to overall operational efficiency.
  • Manage communication with subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring timely and quality delivery of services and materials to bolster operational success.
  • Collaborate with various departments to meet both vessel and global demands, aiding in the enhancement of interdepartmental synergy and response capabilities.
  • Participate in workshops focused on Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices, including Task Risk Analysis and Critical Analysis, to heighten safety awareness and operational readiness.
  • Engage in client meetings to understand contracts and operational responsibilities, enhancing your educational experience.
  • Support the operations interface, promoting seamless interactions across all onshore and offshore departments.

Duties

  • Assist the Onshore Team in maintaining the Operations Management System and the Computerized Maintenance Management System, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Review and update procedures, work instructions, and job descriptions, aligning them with best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft documentation for Purchasing Order/Contract issuance, including Scopes of Work and Technical Analyses.
  • Participate in audits and inspections to assess the compliance and effectiveness of operational processes.
  • Monitor and document the status of material embarkation and disembarkation as well as third‑party mobilisations and payments, relaying essential updates to the team.
  • All internship activities will be conducted onshore; please note the intern will not embark offshore.
  • Engage in quarterly feedback sessions with your supervisor to discuss performance, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • By the end of the internship, you will be well‑versed in articulating the fundamentals of oil, gas, and water topsides, as well as marine processes related to cargo storage, handling, and offloading.

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Responsibilities

  • Maintain a keen awareness of health and safety practices, proactively observing and reporting any unsafe activities, conditions, or situations.
  • Utilise the 'Stop Work' policy whenever unsafe conditions are noted, prioritising safety in all operational undertakings.

Qualifications

  • Mandatory: Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in engineering, with a commitment to a two-year internship.
  • Desirable: Coursework in technical subjects related to operations or engineering.

Skills & Experiences

  • Mandatory: Basic understanding of English and proficiency in MS Office applications.
  • Desirable: Intermediate level of English to facilitate clear communication in a multinational team environment.

Yinson is committed to promoting a diverse workplace and proudly operates as an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, disability, or any other dimension of diversity. Let’s work together to build a sustainable future!
