title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.
    • Identifies and addresses systemic workflow gaps, documentation risks, and handoff failures to ensure audit-ready operations.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Management: Ability to supervise, train, and develop pre-award staff; set priorities; redistribute work during absences; and maintain team stability in a high-volume environment.
  • Expertise in Federal Funding & Compliance: Deep knowledge of NIH, NSF, DoD, and foundation grants, including federal compliance regulations.
  • Proposal Development & Strategy: Strong understanding of sponsor priorities, funding trends, and proposal submission requirements.
  • Operational Process Design: Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.
  • Data Analytics & Process Improvement: Ability to track, analyze, and optimize pre-award workflows and research funding success rates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Skilled in collaborating with faculty, administrators, legal, compliance, and external sponsors to facilitate research success.
  • Contract & Agreement Oversight: Ability to review and sign standard proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, with the judgment to elevate complex cases appropriately.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Extensive experience in grant and contract administration is essential and will carry more weight than advanced credentials.
  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire lifecycle of research award administration, from the proposal phase to the award set-up.
  • Experience with outgoing subaward and consultant agreement administration, including subrecipient monitoring and risk documentation.
  • Must possess a deep understanding of federal contract requirements.
  • Comprehensive grasp of federal research compliance regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Proficiency with enterprise research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday, or similar platforms).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $145,454 - $160,000

title: Gerente de TI
description:
Descrição sumária

Gerenciar e assegurar a operação contínua e estável de sistemas críticos de emissão de apólices e gestão de sinistros, execução de atividades, iniciativas e projetos de infraestrutura, suporte ao usuário, ERP e Dados, visando a transformação, simplificação e otimização do ecossistema computacional da seguradora.

Apoiar o CIO em atividades e planos estratégicos, planos táticos e operacionais, buscando a entrega de soluções tecnológicas de apoio às demandas de negócio.

Identificar oportunidades e novas ferramentas para otimização da execução de projetos de TI e projetos corporativos, com análise de custo/benefício, comparação de eventuais soluções disponíveis no mercado em relação ao desenvolvimento/execução interna, implantar soluções definidas de acordo com as especificações funcionais e auxiliar na elaboração de prazos e orçamentos definidos.

Atribuições do Cargo

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento da estratégia corporativa para transformação na qualidade e prestação de serviços providos pela área de TI para os usuários internos e externos, no alinhamento das metas e objetivos definidos pela área de TI com as metas corporativas;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de “roadmap” para execução de projetos do ponto de vista técnico de TI, seguido de elaboração e execução de plano de ação;
  • Assegurar a aderência das atividades de infraestrutura, ERP, dados e suporte às demandas das áreas de negócios da empresa;
  • Definição de métricas de desempenho da equipe e dos serviços prestados;
  • Identificar, viabilizar a implementação e gerenciar soluções de tecnologia internas e/ou externas para aumentar a eficácia e eficiência operacional, qualidade dos serviços e nível de governança da seguradora, de acordo com as necessidades identificadas/reportadas;
  • Gerenciar, em conjunto com o coordenador da área, o desenvolvimento da infraestrutura, da implantação e atualização de sistemas, softwares e de soluções de tecnologia;
  • Atender demandas do CEO, COO e do CIO e demais diretores quando solicitado;
  • Aplicar processos e políticas de governança da empresa e contribuir com melhorias;
  • Planejar, documentar, executar e testar estratégias e procedimentos de contingências, visando a segurança de dados e informações;
  • Auxiliar nas atividades de auditorias e continuidade dos serviços;
  • Manter monitoramento, avaliação de desempenho e qualificação das equipes, visando a manutenção da motivação, a fim de obter os melhores resultados das atividades da área e a busca pelas melhores soluções técnicas;
  • Buscar tendências de mercado e necessidades identificadas na seguradora para evolução tecnológica dos serviços e soluções ofertados ao mercado;
  • Relacionar‑se com fornecedores de produtos e serviços de tecnologias, garantindo atendimento aos interesses e às necessidades da empresa;
  • Realizar gestão, acompanhamento e cumprimento dos contratos firmados pela área de TI;
  • Cumprir o orçamento anual previsto para a área de TI;
  • Gerenciar as interações com os provedores de soluções externas;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com a Diretoria de TI;
  • Produzir relatório mensal demonstrando resultados, incidentes e monitoramento das atividades em andamento;
  • Garantir integração de produtos e sistemas;
  • Auxiliar na validação de soluções técnicas;
  • Auxiliar na gestão, revisão e conclusão de pontos de auditorias;
  • Analisar e propor melhorias em relação a indicadores de ocorrências;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e padrões;
  • Acompanhar o processo de homologação de equipamentos e softwares de soluções externas visando a transformação e inovação;
  • Conduzir reuniões com equipes de trabalho;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de workshops e treinamentos voltados para a fomentação da transformação & inovação no âmbito da seguradora.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de seis (6) anos como Gerente de TI, com atuação comprovada em infraestrutura, redes e suporte (Service Desk), sendo desejável experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação e simplificação digital de processos, gestão de mudanças e operações em seguros;
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (tempos de resposta, resolução) e níveis de serviço (SLAs);

Nível de instrução

  • Superior em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas e/ou cursos afins;
  • MBA, Especialização ou Pós-Graduação em Gestão de TI, Transformação & Inovação e/ou áreas afins.

Cursos/Certificações/Conhecimentos específicos

  • Experiência em Gestão de Projetos e Metodologia Agile;
  • ITIL Foundation ou Superior (crucial para governança de serviços);
  • PMP ou metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

Fluência em francês ou espanhol

Competências

Liderança de equipes técnicas, excelente comunicação, capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multidisciplinar, dinâmico e sob pressão (especialmente em momentos de crises, como DR e Alta Disponibilidade), visão sistêmica, visão estratégica de negócio, tomada de decisão, negociação, organização, raciocínio lógico e resiliência.

  • Vale-alimentação e Vale-refeição atrativos

  • Conhecimento em organização e padronização de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento em Google Earth e ferramentas de apoio à análise espacial;
  • Experiência com modelagem ambiental espacial (ex.: apoio a estudos ambientais, diagnósticos ou planejamento);
  • Conhecimento em automação de processos geoespaciais (ex.: uso inicial Python, scripts);
  • Experiência prévia em análises espaciais em projetos ambientais;
  • Conhecimentos introdutórios em Inteligência Artificial ou Machine Learning aplicados ao geoprocessamento;
  • Conhecimento de GPS e manipulação de dados GNSS (GPSTrackMaker, Global Mapper);

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Assistant Director – Military and Veterans Services (ADMVS) directs, plans, and organizes all veterans’ services initiatives. The ADMVS assists with and helps lead the department's vision, goals, and objectives for the department. The ADMVS reports to the Director of Student Services.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. The ADMVS performs the administrative and technical duties required to establish and maintain a program to assist Military connected individuals in obtaining educational, financial, social services and other benefits available through the Federal, State and local legislation. This position requires evening and weekend hours and accessibility as student needs arise.

Supervisory Accountability

Direct supervision of two Veterans Affairs Coordinators (Certifying School Officials). Supervision of one Veteran Resource Coordinator.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as point of contact for veteran's educational programs, policies, procedures and regulations
  • Serve as liaison between HU and the VA for eligibility for veteran students
  • Develop and expand the University's relationships with other U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and other services agencies
  • Provide accurate information to all interested parties regarding current educational benefits and programs which are provided by federal and state government and local agencies to support veterans
  • Counsel students and parents concerning eligibility and benefits available under various programs
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state government reporting requirements related to veterans’ educational benefits
  • Manage and monitor schedule changes, major changes, withdrawals, audits and inapplicable courses for appropriate changes in benefits
  • Implement control measures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of certification
  • Establish and maintain student VA files
  • Coordinate with the office of Admission and Recruiting, Records and Registration, Financial Aid, and Disabilities Services to improve the enrollment process for military connected students
  • Recommend, implement, and administer methods and procedures to enhance recruitment efforts
  • Develop a working knowledge of ASU academic programs that are of interest to veterans’ students
  • Evaluate U.S. Armed Forces transcripts for transfer credit and transfer equivalencies
  • Develop and maintain the department's website
  • Represent the University on committees and advisory groups that work to advance and enhance VA benefits, and state and regional organizations that assist veteran students with four-year college graduation
  • Actively promote programs that engage veterans and the campus community
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Senior Leaders within The Office of Student Services and Student Affairs

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Partner with the Howard University Bursar’s office for seamless and streamlined communication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with the financial aid office
  • Provide recommendations, tools and resources for faculty and staff to assist them in how to support military connected students
  • Develop, cultivate, and sustain collaborative and effective working relationships with key stakeholders outside the Division of Student Affairs

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, critical thinking, professional judgment, oral and written communication
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population
  • Self-directed; self-motivated individual who can work autonomously with minimal supervision while managing multiple situations
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, follow through, meet deadlines, and make professional decisions
  • Ability to work independently, collaboratively across multiple offices and in a team environment
  • Flexibility and accessibility particularly as it relates to responding to and attending to student needs
  • Demonstrated work ethic that illustrates integrity, ethics, sound professional judgment and an appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Competent and comfortable with technology and ability to utilize data to inform decisions
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with exceptionally good judgment and discretion
  • Experience supervising employees, including hiring and evaluation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in education, training, and experience
  • 3-5 years of experience with student support initiatives in higher education or a similar setting
  • Previous Military Services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Counseling, Public Health, Education, Higher Education, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field
  • 5-7 years related experience
  • Ability to build knowledge base of national trends and best practices

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

description:
Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.
  • M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

About The Team

The Core Services Team builds and maintains the mission‑critical, high‑throughput, and fault‑tolerant foundational services that power the entire Uber platform. This includes global‑scale services for Safety, Identity, Payments, and other core business logic.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who operates with a broad scope, influencing the technical direction not just within your team but across multiple dependent platform and product teams. You will drive the design and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems, setting a high bar for engineering excellence and mentoring senior engineers across the organization.

  • Lead the design and architecture of large‑scale, resilient backend services and distributed systems for core platform components (e.g., ensuring high availability, sub‑millisecond latency, and strict data consistency).
  • Own complex backend technical initiatives that impact major product areas or multiple infrastructure and cross‑platform engineering teams.
  • Drive technical decision‑making and establish architectural standards and patterns for the wider Core Services organization, focusing on scalability, security, and multi‑region fault tolerance.
  • Implement critical, high‑performance backend features and microservices using modern languages (e.g., Go, Java) and infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Cassandra, Redis), ensuring they are secure and maintainable.
  • Champion a culture of operational excellence by establishing best practices for observability, proactive monitoring, automated load testing, and incident response.
  • Aggressively identify and resolve systemic technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and non‑performant queries/logic across foundational backend systems.
  • Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to define technical roadmaps that align with long‑term business strategy, specifically regarding the evolution of our core service APIs and data models.
  • Represent the team and its technical strategy in cross‑organizational forums and drive consensus on complex technical tradeoffs between feature velocity, system stability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Act as a force multiplier by mentoring other backend engineers, elevating the technical capabilities and "systems thinking" of the entire organization.
  • Provide in‑depth, rigorous feedback in design and code reviews for critical systems, emphasizing distributed systems best practices, concurrency safety, and resource efficiency.
  • Contribute to the engineering culture by championing best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security‑first development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience in designing, building, and operating large‑scale, high‑availability distributed systems in a production environment.
  • Deep expertise in Backend Infrastructure: Strong mastery of microservices architecture, distributed databases, caching strategies, and asynchronous messaging systems.
  • Proven Leadership: Ability to lead multi‑quarter projects, break down ambiguous technical problems, and drive complex initiatives to successful completion across team boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • SRE Principles: Deep experience with site reliability engineering, including error budgeting, SLO/SLA definition, and building self‑healing systems.
  • Influence: A track record of influencing backend engineering strategy and architecture across different organizational boundaries and functional areas.

title: MEDICO PNEUMOLOGISTA DIARISTA- HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes. O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Realizar a contra referência do paciente à Unidade Básica de Saúde de sua referência após a alta ambulatorial ou durante o acompanhamento dos casos crônicos que permanecerem por mais tempo em acompanhamento no serviço conforme Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria em pneumologista

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Informações adicionais

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 20h semanais

Horário: a combinar

title: Especialista de segurança do trabalho I
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gerenciar o Sistema de Gestão de SST Axia, garantindo conformidade legal e melhoria contínua (PDCA).
  • Conduzir análises de risco em atividades de Sistema Elétrico de Potência (SEP): APR/JSA, Matriz de Riscos, LOTO e Liberação de PT (Permissão de Trabalho) para intervenção em linhas de transmissão (LT), subestações (SE) e usinas hidrelétricas (UHE).
  • Responder tecnicamente pela segurança de atividades críticas: trabalhos em altura (NR 35), espaços confinados (NR 33), energia elétrica (NR 10 – Básico e SEP), máquinas e equipamentos (NR 12), movimentação de cargas (NR 11/NR 18 quando aplicável), escavações (NR 18), e frentes remotas/obras lineares.
  • Planejar e auditar o GRO/PGR (Gerenciamento de Riscos Ocupacionais / Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), inventário de riscos, plano de ação, procedimentos operacionais e planos de resposta a emergências (incl. simulações em SE/UHE e integração com Brigada).
  • Investigar incidentes e acidentes (com e sem afastamento) com metodologia estruturada, emitir relatórios, ART quando aplicável, e garantir implementação/eficácia das ações corretivas.
  • Aprovar e acompanhar obras, montagens eletromecânicas, comissionamentos e manutenções programadas/emergenciais, incluindo análise de riscos de pátios de manobra, casas de força, vertedouros e barragens, e gestão de interfaces com O&M.
  • Gestão de contratadas: qualificação (prérequisitos de SST), auditorias de campo e de documentação (ASOs, treinamentos legais, certificações), verificação de EPC/EPI e desempenho de indicadores (TRIFR, LTIFR, taxa de gravidade, near miss).
  • Gestão de mudanças (MoC) em projetos e operações (mudanças de tecnologia, método, pessoal, instalações), incluindo APR de mudança e revalidação de procedimentos.
  • Conduzir programas de cultura de segurança: diálogos diários (DDS), campanhas, treinamentos e Paradas/Diálogos de Segurança; atuar como referência técnica para liderança, CIPA e SESMT.
  • Gestão documental: prontuários, PPRA/PGR histórico, PCMSO (com Médico do Trabalho), registros de inspeções (checklists LT/SE/UHE), prontuário de NR 10, prontuário de máquinas/NR 12, certificados, laudos, ART e relatórios executivos para diretoria.
  • Apoiar avaliações de riscos de empreendimentos (greenfield/brownfield) e definição de requisitos de segurança no engenharia de projeto (HSE by design).
  • Disponibilidade para campo e viagens em corredores de LT, canteiros, SEs e UHEs; atuação em múltiplos sites e em cenários de contingência (plantões/eventos críticos).

Requisitos e Qualificações

Habilidades e Conhecimentos

  • Legislação e Normas: NRs (especialmente NR 1 – GRO/PGR, NR 6, NR 10 (Básico e SEP), NR 12, NR 18, NR 33, NR 35), ABNT NBR aplicáveis ao setor elétrico, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, boas práticas de OHS/EHS.
  • Análise de Riscos e Investigação: APR/JSA, FMEA, HAZOP (aplicável a processos auxiliares), BowTie, LOTO, RCA/ICAM/TapRooT, Análise de Causa Raiz, Auditorias de Campo.
  • Operação em SEP: entendimento de riscos de indução, campos elétricos e magnéticos, correntes de fuga, zonas controladas, aterramento temporário, coordenação com operação do sistema, restrições de aproximação, desenergização e reenergização segura.
  • Gestão de Contratadas e Obras: mobilização/aceite, auditorias, KPIs de segurança, liberação de frentes, integração de novos contratos.
  • Resposta a Emergências: linhas energizadas, arco elétrico, quedas de altura, espaços confinados, resgate técnico, incidentes ambientais correlatos.
  • Ferramentas: Pacote Office (Excel avançado, PowerPoint, Word), Power BI (desejável domínio de dashboards), softwares de EHS (Enablon, Intelex, SOGI, Quirius ou similares), ferramentas de gestão de manutenção (CMMS/ERP) e controle de documentos (EDMS).
  • Idiomas: Português fluente; Inglês técnico (leitura de normas, relatórios e interação com fornecedores internacionais).
  • Atuações anteriores com análises de risco, liberação de atividades críticas, avaliação de projetos (HSE by design) e gestão de contratadas em empreendimentos de Transmissão (LT/SE) e Geração Hidrelétrica (UHE).
  • Suporte e interface com as áreas de Projetos, Construção, O&M, Jurídico, Suprimentos e Meio Ambiente, garantindo que os requisitos de SST sejam incorporados desde a engenharia até a operação.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos customizados ao setor elétrico (SEP, arco elétrico, resgate em altura/torres, indução em linhas vizinhas, riscos hidromecânicos em UHE).
  • Consolidar e reportar indicadores e planos executivos de SST à alta liderança, apoiando tomada de decisão baseada em risco e priorização de investimentos.
  • Formação superior e especialização completa com Segurança do trabalho.
  • CNH B e disponibilidade para viagens.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Auditor Líder em ISO 45001 e/ou ISO 14001.
  • Formação complementar: curso de Análise de Arco Elétrico (NFPA 70E ou equivalente), NR 13 (caldeiras/vasos de pressão, se aplicável), Resgate Técnico em Altura/Confinado, Gestão de Mudanças (MoC), HAZOP líder.

title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

This URL is for benefits and wellness: Function

The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain scheduling and tracking systems for long-acting injectable HIV medications.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff and specialty pharmacies to ensure timely medication procurement and dosing.
  • Monitor injection schedules and proactively address potential delays or barriers to care.
  • Assist with patient reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up outreach to reduce missed visits.
  • Perform patient check-in and check-out procedures.
  • Verify insurance eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient interactions and care coordination activities in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
  • Support reporting initiatives related to patient engagement and viral suppression outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, nurses, case managers, and pharmacy partners.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred).
  • Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

title: Coordenador(a) de Auditoria Interna
description:
Escopo geográfico do cargo:

Nacional

Área geográfica:

Brasil, Rio de Janeiro

Impacto do cargo nos resultados financeiros:

O cargo atua em um mercado regulado. O Brasil apresenta alta complexidade regulatória e está sujeito a mudanças frequentes. Além disso, SOX é uma regulamentação global.

Stakeholders relacionados ao cargo:

  • Colaboradores responsáveis pelos controles SOX (execução e validação);
  • CODIR da Filial;
  • Equipe de Controle Interno e Governança da Matriz;
  • Equipe de Auditoria Interna da Matriz;
  • Equipe de Auditoria de Joint Ventures da Matriz;
  • Parceiros de Joint Venture;
  • Nível de contato: Nível 2 – requer capacidade de influenciar e convencer;

Horizonte de Reflexão:

Horizonte: Médio prazo (1–3 anos).

Objetivo: Implementar diretrizes por meio da otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar as atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, visando salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, e contribuir para a eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da empresa.
  • Apoiar o(a) Gerente de Governança Corporativa no planejamento anual (missões de auditoria da matriz, plano de auditoria, KPIs, etc.).
  • Coordenar, motivar, liderar e desenvolver a equipe de Auditoria Interna, acompanhando seu desempenho e desenvolvimento de carreira.
  • Estimular inovação e novas ideias nas atividades de auditoria.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam em conformidade com os padrões de Governança e acordos de Joint Venture (Compliance/Integridade, Sistema de Gestão da Companhia – CMS, Sarbanes-Oxley – SOX, requisitos regulatórios, acordos com parceiros de JV, etc.).
  • Conduzir auditorias internas (JV, BV, controles SOX e processos locais), incluindo planejamento, execução, delegação, reporte e acompanhamento.
  • Assegurar o acompanhamento da implementação das recomendações de auditoria (Matriz, Interna e JV) e revisar o MEMO trimestral de follow-up de auditoria.
  • Garantir a atualização regular das ferramentas de auditoria (ex.: ferramenta JVADB, arquivo ACI, etc.).
  • Coordenar o planejamento anual de auditoria de Joint Ventures e comunicar adequadamente internamente a e aos parceiros (processo de exercício do direito de auditoria).
  • Coordenar os testes dos controles SOX, incluindo planejamento, delegação, supervisão e revisão dos resultados (relatório de auditoria SOX).
  • Coordenar o mapeamento de riscos, garantindo o acompanhamento dos planos de ação acordados com os responsáveis.
  • Promover discussões para aumentar a conscientização sobre riscos, boas práticas de auditoria e disseminar a cultura de Auditoria Interna na afiliada.

Finalidade do Cargo:

O(A) Coordenador(a) de Auditoria Interna suporta o(a) Gerente de Governança Corporativa garantindo por meio das auditorias realizadas a conformidade com as políticas de governança da TotalEnergies, com os requisitos da legislação SOX e com os acordos de Joint-Venture.

Também conduz exercícios de mapeamento de riscos de forma proativa, assegura a responsabilização entre as áreas e fomenta uma cultura de gestão de riscos na afiliada.

O cargo é responsável pelo reporte regular de assuntos de auditoria, proporcionando ao(à) Gerente de Governança Corporativa uma visão confiável sobre processos, controles e exposição a riscos da afiliada.

Formação:

Graduação em Finanças (Contabilidade, Economia ou Administração).

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência em Auditoria e Finanças.
  • Forte conhecimento da legislação SOX.
  • Alta capacidade de planejamento e síntese.
  • Microsoft Office 365 – nível intermediário/avançado.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Boa comunicação e liderança de equipes
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e com prazos curtos
  • Forte pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas
  • Capacidade de compreender a complexidade do negócio e adaptar‑se rapidamente a mudanças
  • Comunicação oral e escrita eficaz em todos os níveis.

Certificações:

  • Experiência em Auditoria Externa (Big 4 como diferencial).
  • Experiência com controles SOX.
  • Experiência no setor de Óleo & Gás.

Experiência Profissional:

Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna ou Externa, preferencialmente no setor de Energia.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a área:

A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho:

Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
  • Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
  • Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
  • Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
  • Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
  • Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;
  • Experiência na análise de métricas de redes sociais, utilizando dados e indicadores de performance para embasar tomadas de decisão estratégicas e otimização de resultados;
  • Vivência na criação e proposição de soluções criativas, alinhadas às linguagens, tendências e referências das redes sociais, garantindo relevância cultural e engajamento;
  • Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;
  • Experiência na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas em PowerPoint, com clareza narrativa, organização de informações e foco em objetivos de negócio;
  • Conhecimento e uso do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel, aplicado à análise, organização e acompanhamento de dados e indicadores;
  • Vivência na gestão de orçamentos de campanhas e produções, assegurando controle financeiro, eficiência de custos e otimização de recursos;
  • Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação direta na gestão, engajamento e evolução de equipes;
  • Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
  • Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Conhecimento e atuação prévia com agências de influenciadores do mercado.

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:

description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications, delivering high‑quality data collection and project management capabilities covering quantitative and qualitative techniques.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast‑paced environment developing complex applications. The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts, lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object‑oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. Responsibilities include

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.
  • Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud‑based architecture.
  • Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability.
  • Set and promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members.
  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high‑impact solutions and deliver high‑quality applications.
  • Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Node.js, with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.
  • Knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle.
  • Experience with modern front‑end frameworks, specifically React or Angular, and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development.
  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE, with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats.
  • Team‑oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities, capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem‑solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile‑first development and responsive design is a plus.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI‑enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

  • Applicants located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.

title: MPD Supervisor
description:
Descrição do Cargo

Reports to: Drilling Superintendent

Offshore Drilling Group

Pre-Requisite / Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.) / Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Valid Well Control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix
  • Ability to use hydraulic modelling software.
  • Computer literate including a high level of competence in Microsoft Office.
  • Require 5+ years Offshore MPD Experience
  • OEM Managed Pressure Drilling operations training

General Requirements

  • Promotes a safe and respectful work environment: proactively promotes and maintains open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement.
  • Attends and participates in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Completes company training requirements for the MPD Supervisor job level as per the training matrix, including local and regulatory requirements.
  • Observes duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position.
  • Fully participates in emergency drills and responds to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Performs roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understands hazards associated with the task.
  • Effectively implements control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Executes all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognises risky behaviour or conditions during tasks and calls ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure.
  • Participates in After Action Reviews to provide feedback and updates to the MPD manager.
  • Reports deviations from TOI procedures when using third‑party MPD procedures.

HSE Requirements

  • Reports all incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to supervisors.
  • Actively performs work in accordance with Company Safety Processes, e.g. START, Task Planning Risk Assessment, Prompt Card, Safe Manual Handling, Working at Heights.
  • Calls Time Out for Safety (TOFS) when the plan is unclear or an unsafe condition is observed.
  • Participates in the rigs ‘Hold the Zero’ plan.
  • Complies with company requirements to safeguard lone workers.
  • Maintains a safe and organised work area throughout all tasks.
  • Integrates the Task Planning and Risk Assessment process into all tasks.
  • Ensures subordinate personnel are trained in the START and PTW processes.
  • Communicates Company QHSE policies and programmes to and ensures they are understood by all personnel.
  • Acts in weekly meetings, FOCUS Improvement Program, and other company safety management systems.
  • Maintains high hygiene and housekeeping standards in areas of responsibility.
  • Ensures subordinates understand their roles in the Emergency Response Plan.
  • Performs required well‑control drills, conducts After Action Reviews and ensures findings are communicated.
  • Ensures DROPS inspections are conducted per the rig’s inspection programme.
  • Participates in MPD HazOp, HazID and FMECA as required by the MPD manager.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements.

Operations / Maintenance

  • Fully knowledgeable in all aspects of MPD operations on floating drilling vessels and MPD variants.
  • Prepares operational procedures approved by the MPD manager and secures approval for changes.
  • Performs all calculations for Kick Tolerance, IME and updates the Operations Matrix.
  • Ensures all BHA and pipe tallies are accurate, with required information entered into the MPD model.
  • Monitors maintenance, repair and installation of all MPD equipment and records inventory levels.
  • Maintains inspection and certification records for MPD equipment and tools.
  • Supports the Company Rig Maintenance System (AIM) for MPD department tasks with subsea.
  • Reviews and approves all MPD‑related Permit to Work as the responsible person for the task.
  • Supervises equipment preparation for impending MPD operations.
  • Liaises with the MPD manager on major maintenance activities such as IRJ 12‑month inspection.
  • When using the rig’s existing MGS, ensures the IME, Ops Matrix and procedures capture the maximum flow rates with a 100% safety factor.
  • Plans job activities of MPD service providers and associated activities.
  • Ensures MPD well‑control requirements are in place and supervises well‑control events.
  • Performs all MPD well‑control calculations (e.g., mud weight, circulating pressures, strokes).
  • Assists the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher or OIM in coordinating third‑party personnel activities.
  • Prepares requisition purchase orders for equipment or parts necessary to avoid MPD downtime.
  • Ensures sufficient stock of parts and materials is maintained for MPD equipment.
  • Communicates progress of MPD and associated operations to the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher and OIM.
  • Recommends adjustments to drilling parameters to improve MPD performance.
  • Ensures regular effective well‑MPD drills are conducted and recorded.

Personnel

  • Promotes and maintains good relationships with other departments, third‑party personnel and customer representatives.
  • Ensures MPD personnel meet training requirements per their training matrix.
  • Mentors, coaches, develops and trains crew members for MPD competence.
  • Provides leadership and motivation to drilling crews during MPD operations and applies continuous improvement.
  • Mentors the driller and assistant driller in MPD operations.
  • Carrying out MPD operations in alignment with TOI MPD training philosophy.
  • Assists in training to ensure all personnel are competent for their assigned jobs.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process.
  • Applies appropriate accountability regarding recognition, promotion or disciplinary actions up to and including discharge.
