Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organizationally to the Accommodation Manager in Rio de Janeiro, the Accommodation Coordinator will help serve Accommodation efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ is hosting 32 teams and 700+ players across Brazil and 8 host cities/ venues. This role will be responsible for coordinating lodging and hotel-related arrangements for the event, ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience for teams, participants and attendees. Further, this role will have a range of responsibilities, including contracting hotels, coordinating inventory, F&B, AV, meetings space, and reconciling and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contract hotels ensuring they meet quality standards and core group requirements
  • Ensure hotels comply with all contractual obligations
  • Execute tasks and addendums necessary for adjustments to hotel contracts
  • Coordinate reservations, rooming lists, changes and requests for core groups
  • Provide excellent customer service to official tournament guests
  • Coordinate hotel room blocks, meeting space, F&B, AV, group requirements, hotel communications and reservation management
  • Provide resources and information to guests, create presentation materials
  • Support booking and reservation processes for guests
  • Keep all necessary internal and external reporting up to date
  • Ensure held inventory is in accordance with remaining demand
  • Attend site visits, familiarize with hotels and tour constituent groups
  • Coordinate the reconciliation, billing and closeout at hotels and with groups
  • Support and address unforeseen changes, cancellations, or emergencies in accommodation arrangements
  • Build strong relationships with designated groups to provide excellent experience within the overall accommodation strategy
  • Consider all operational aspects when coordinating hotel arrangements, for example, transportation, logistics, security, etc.
  • Uphold and enforce high standards of customer service, ensuring participants and guests have a memorable and enjoyable experience during their stay
  • Establish relationships with the hotel industry to provide the best overall value for FIFA
  • Ensure records of accommodation bookings, rooming lists, and related information comply with data integrity and protection regulations
  • Coordinate various ancillary projects taking place in the leadup to the Women’s World Cup

Your Profile

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education.
  • Minimum of 2 years of work experience in the hospitality industry.
  • Strong communication skills – oral and written.
  • Experience coordinating complex projects.
  • Strong organizational, customer service and attention to detail.
  • Fluent/Native in English and Portuguese are required for this position.
  • Knowledge of other languages is considered a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

Reporting to the Director of Onsite Subsurface Science and Engineering (SSE) services, the Senior Geoscience Consultant will be responsible for delivering dedicated and onsite services to a large National Oil Company.

  • Experience with Formation Evaluation Solutions (e.g., Geolog), Seismic Characterization Solutions (e.g., SeisEarth), and Geomodelling solutions (e.g., SKUA, RMS) from AspenTech considered a plus.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Collections Counselor supports students with aging or past-due balances by providing clear, accurate, and compassionate financial guidance. The role conducts proactive outreach, explains payment options, resolves discrepancies, documents activity thoroughly, and collaborates with campus partners to help students regain good financial standing. The position ensures all counseling and communications align with university policies, federal regulations, and service quality standards.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Collections Counselor serves as a frontline financial support specialist within Student Accounts, working directly with students whose balances require follow-up or repayment. The Counselor communicates regularly via phone, email, ticketing, and in-person appointments—occasionally during nontraditional hours—to explain account status, payment plans, holds, and next steps. The role requires strong communication skills, customer-service orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to support adult and traditional learners navigating financial challenges. The incumbent works closely with Collections Leads, Student Accounts Advisors, Cashiering Services, Financial Aid, the Registrar’s Office, Treasury, and other campus partners to resolve discrepancies, verify adjustments, and support the timely and accurate processing of payments. The Counselor reinforces university expectations while maintaining a student-centered, empathetic approach.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outreach to students with past-due balances to explain account status, payment requirements, repayment options, and consequences of nonpayment.
  • Provide empathetic, student-centered counseling on payment plans, outstanding charges, financial holds, and available resources.
  • Assist students with setting up, monitoring, and understanding payment plan terms, deadlines, and consequences for missed payments.
  • Conduct thorough account reviews, identify discrepancies, and elevate complex or unusual cases to the Collections Lead.
  • Process returned payments, verify financial adjustments, and coordinate with Financial Aid, Registrar, and Cashiering to ensure accurate account updates.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of all outreach, counseling sessions, follow-up actions, and resolutions in accordance with departmental policy.
  • Ensure compliance with FERPA, FDCPA, institutional procedures, and established scripts and communication standards.
  • Prepare routine reports and status updates to support monitoring of aging balances and collection activities.
  • Provide high-quality, professional customer service and reinforce university policy while helping students work toward financial stability.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrates empathy, patience, and clarity when helping students in financial distress.
  • Accurately interprets account activity and identifies appropriate next steps.
  • Communicates clearly and concisely across phone, email, ticketing, and in-person interactions.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-campus partners to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Maintains accuracy in account reviews, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and supporting evening or nontraditional service hours.
  • Understands billing, collections, payment plan structures, financial aid interactions, and registration impacts.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and related experience may be considered.
  • Basic understanding of accounts receivable processes.
  • One to two years of experience in customer service, billing, student accounts, accounts receivable, financial aid, or another financial operations role.
  • Experience supporting adult learners or students facing financial hardship preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Ability to handle confidential information and comply with FERPA, FDCPA, and institutional guidelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze account data, identify discrepancies, and escalation complex issues appropriately.
  • Experience with ERP or student information systems (Workday preferred; training provided).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up tasks in a high-volume environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Financial Aid, Cashiering, Registrar, Treasury, and other campus partners.

Expected Salary Range

$63,000 - $70,000

Sobre a Duetti

A Duetti está redefinindo a forma como criadores independentes de música monetizam e expandem suas carreiras. Fundada em 2022 pelo CEO Lior Tibon e pelo COO Christopher Nolte, a Duetti faz parcerias com criadores para destravar o valor de seus catálogos por meio de acordos flexíveis e transparentes, ao mesmo tempo em que oferece serviços de alto nível de gestão de catálogo, distribuição e marketing. Desde sua fundação, a Duetti já firmou parceria com mais de 1.100 criadores de música em 40 países, incluindo Connor Price, Ingrid Contreras e Brent Morgan, ajudando-os a monetizar suas músicas em seus próprios termos e alcançar novos públicos.

Apoiando-se em investidores de destaque como The Raine Group, Flexpoint Ford, Nyca Partners, Viola Ventures e Roc Nation, a Duetti já levantou mais de US$ 635 milhões em capital para financiar criadores independentes. Impulsionada pela crença na independência e no empoderamento financeiro, a Duetti está construindo um futuro mais sustentável para criadores de música em todo o mundo. Com escritórios em Nova York, Los Angeles, Miami e Londres, a Duetti oferece benefícios competitivos, política flexível de folgas remuneradas e um modelo de trabalho híbrido. Temos orgulho de uma cultura que combina ambição com cuidado genuíno — um ambiente onde o seu trabalho impacta diretamente os resultados para artistas ao redor do mundo.

Descrição da Vaga

Como Deal Executive na Duetti, você estará no centro da nossa missão voltada aos artistas, atuando como um elo fundamental com nossos artistas parceiros e suas equipes. Você trabalhará lado a lado com os gerentes de A&R da Duetti em nossos acordos mais estratégicos e complexos, garantindo que eles atendam tanto aos objetivos da empresa quanto aos dos artistas.

Você terá um papel essencial na formulação e execução da estratégia de A&R da Duetti, colaborando de perto com a liderança sênior da empresa. Sua atuação ficará na interseção entre Música, Operações e Análise de Dados, contribuindo diretamente para a missão da Duetti de democratizar a monetização de catálogos musicais.

Você irá:
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de A&R da Duetti para negociar e executar nossos acordos mais complexos e de atendimento altamente personalizado, diretamente com nossos artistas parceiros e suas equipes, além de desenvolver soluções criativas para os desafios encontrados pelo time de A&R.
  • Desenvolver e cultivar relacionamentos com artistas, empresários e outros agentes da indústria.
  • Apoiar o time de A&R no alcance de metas e marcos ambiciosos em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor, estratégias de concorrentes e tecnologias emergentes no espaço de fintech musical.
Requisitos:
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em vendas ou desenvolvimento de negócio em uma empresa de música ou fintech.
  • Forte compreensão da indústria musical e capacidade de interpretar estruturas contratuais complexas.

title: Consultoria para Soluções Automatizadas de Monitoramento e Dados de Comunicação
description:
SOBRE O CPI

O Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) é uma organização com experiência internacional em análise de políticas públicas e finanças, que possui sete escritórios ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, é afiliado à Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio). O CPI/PUC-Rio atua no aprimoramento de políticas públicas e financiamento climático no Brasil através de análises baseadas em evidência e parcerias estratégicas com membros do governo, da sociedade civil, do setor privado e de instituições financeiras.

ESCOPO

  • Coleta automatizada de métricas de redes sociais e dashboard analítico: desenvolver solução para coleta automatizada de métricas de LinkedIn e Instagram, utilizando as APIs oficiais das plataformas, contemplando todos os canais digitais do CPI, estruturando os dados e criando um dashboard para visualização e análise dos indicadores.
  • Sistema de coleta de menções ao CPI e dashboard de clipping: desenvolver sistema para coleta, organização e mensuração de menções ao CPI Brasil e aos seus pesquisadores na imprensa nacional, internacional e em meios digitais, incluindo portais de notícias, blogs e redes sociais, com capacidade de atualização e inclusão de novos termos, e incluir dashboard para consolidação e visualização das menções coletadas.
  • Ferramenta de monitoramento de palavras-chave e dashboard de monitoramento (social listening): desenvolver solução para monitoramento contínuo de palavras-chave relevantes ao CPI em imprensa e meios digitais, com capacidade de atualização e inclusão de novos termos.

As soluções devem ser replicáveis, atualizáveis e permitir a inclusão de novos termos e fontes.

ENTREGÁVEIS

A Consultoria Deverá Entregar:

  • Solução de coleta de métricas de redes sociais: sistema automatizado para extração e organização periódica de métricas de LinkedIn e Instagram, envolvendo múltiplas contas/perfis, consolidação e comparação de dados entre canais, métricas de alcance, impressões, engajamento, interações e seguidores, alinhadas às necessidades do CPI, com dashboard analítico contendo KPIs, visualizações de tendência, filtros por período, plataforma e canal, e interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.
  • Sistema de coleta e mensuração de menções ao CPI Brasil: ferramenta para identificação, coleta e organização de menções ao CPI Brasil e aos seus pesquisadores na imprensa e em meios digitais, consolidando menções de diferentes fontes, organizando-as de forma estruturada (veículo, data, link, autor, tipo de mídia), mensurando volume de menções e alcance/audiência quando disponível, e permitindo consolidação e consulta dos dados ao longo do tempo, com dashboard de clipping visualizando volume ao longo do tempo, distribuição por tipo de mídia/fonte, filtros por período e variáveis relevantes, interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.
  • Ferramenta de monitoramento de palavras-chave: solução contínua para monitoramento de palavras-chave relevantes ao CPI em imprensa e meios digitais, permitindo acompanhamento de termos definidos pelo CPI, coleta e organização de menções, inclusão e atualização de termos ao longo do tempo, estruturação de dados para análise de tendências e volume de menções, com dashboard estruturado exibindo volume por palavra-chave ao longo do tempo, comparação entre termos monitorados, filtros por período e fonte, interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.

Obs.: Todas as entregas devem incluir documentação simples de uso e atualização. As soluções desenvolvidas deverão permitir a inclusão e atualização de novos canais, fontes e termos de monitoramento pelo CPI, sem necessidade de alterações estruturais ou suporte contínuo do(a) consultor(a).

CRONOGRAMA

Duração total: 3 meses.

  • Mês 1: Entrega da solução de métricas de redes sociais.
  • Mês 2: Entrega da solução de coleta de menções ao CPI Brasil.
  • Mês 3: Entrega da plataforma de social listening.

Pagamentos vinculados à entrega e aprovação de cada etapa.

DOCUMENTAÇÃO DOS ENTREGÁVEIS

A documentação clara, completa e bem estruturada é parte integrante de cada produto entregue. Não serão aceitos produtos sem documentação adequada.

  • Descrição da arquitetura da solução implementada.
  • Instruções de configuração e dependências (bibliotecas, credenciais, tokens de API).
  • Guia de uso para usuários finais em linguagem acessível.
  • Manual de manutenção técnica, incluindo procedimentos para atualização de integrações, renovação de credenciais e resolução de problemas comuns.
  • Registro de limitações técnicas e recomendações para melhorias futuras.

A documentação deverá ser suficiente para garantir a operação, atualização e manutenção das soluções de forma autônoma pela equipe do CPI, com orientações claras para inclusão de novos canais, fontes e termos de monitoramento, sem dependência do(a) consultor(a). Os entregáveis deverão ser fornecidos em formato digital, em arquivo aberto (editável), conforme a natureza de cada produto.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

Obrigatórias:

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA e/ou automação de dados.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs (especialmente redes sociais).
  • Experiência em coleta e estruturação de dados digitais em larga escala.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com NLP (processamento de linguagem natural) para análise de texto.
  • Experiência com social listening e/ou clipping automatizado.
  • Conhecimento em Python ou linguagens similares.

CONSIDERAÇÕES FINAIS

A execução dos trabalhos não implica relação de emprego ou vínculo trabalhista com o CPI/PUC-Rio.

Todas as informações, dados, planilhas e materiais produzidos no âmbito desta consultoria são de propriedade do Climate Policy Initiative/PUC-Rio. A pessoa consultora firmará termo de confidencialidade e se comprometerá a não divulgar dados ou resultados sem autorização prévia.

O código-fonte e os materiais desenvolvidos deverão ser integralmente entregues ao CPI/PUC-Rio antes do encerramento do contrato.

O CPI é comprometido com os pilares de Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento. Candidatura preferencial de pessoas pretas e pardas, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e indígenas e de povos e/ou comunidades tradicionais.

title: Transport Client Services Manager
description:
Transport Client Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Transport Client Services Manager role exists both tactical (pre‑Tournament) and operationally (Tournament time) – shifting from planning & relationship management to execution & issue resolution.

The Transport Client Service Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and delivery of transport services for designated client groups during FWWC2027. Acting as the primary liaison between the Transport Functional Area and key stakeholders (such as FIFA Constituent Groups including; Teams, Referees, FIFA Senior Officials, Delegates and Guests, Workforce, Media & Broadcast and Commercial Affiliates), the role ensures that client transport requirements are accurately captured, planned, and operationally delivered in alignment with the FIFA Transport Operating Concept.

During the pre‑Tournament phase, the Manager oversees client engagement, gathers and validates detailed mobility requirements, and translates these into Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role is responsible for delivering the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs) according to agreed timelines and for gaining the necessary agreements and approvals, ensuring that the role works cross‑functionally with fleet planning, Venue and Arrivals and Departures Teams to ensure feasibility, readiness, and service alignment. The position also contributes to test events, readiness exercises, and data accuracy.

During Tournament time, the Transport Client Service Manager becomes the operational lead for assigned client groups, monitoring service performance, managing daily communications, resolving issues in real time, and coordinating adjustments from the Transport Operations Center. The role is accountable for maintaining service reliability, managing escalations, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.

In addition to the above, the role will provide support for the following Event Transport sub‑projects planning and implementation:

  • Developing Transport policies, procedures, Operational Plan and reports.
  • To build, train and motivate the Client Services team of paid staff and volunteers for the duration of the FWWC2027 Tournament.

The successful candidate is expected to be a self‑starter and multitasker who works well under pressure, can lead and manage a team and delivers to strict timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, manage and lead a team of Client Service.
  • Coordinate the transport and arrivals and departures service planning for each client group as named above to ensure the correct services, in accordance with FIFA service levels are planned for each client group to ensure the overall success of the tournament.
  • Liaison, in coordination with other transport stakeholders, with all transport mode suppliers including bus, fleet and public transport and other key functional areas to develop the services.
  • Direct the delivery of the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs), per client group. Ensure all agreements and necessary approvals are gained with client owners, transport service delivery functions both internal to FWWC2027 and external partners / suppliers and FIFA.
  • Lead the client services team to ensure all client service level planning is integrated with other key FWWC2027 functional areas at site and venue level including all stadiums and non‑competition sites.
  • Lead on ensuring the DSLAs are fully integrated with all concerned stakeholders.
  • Work closely with other transport team members (Bus, Fleet and Venues) to ensure the most efficient services are planned and delivered for each client group in line with agreed budgets.
  • Always with the aim of delivering the best client experience and optimising efficiencies where possible.
  • Lead on the delivery of all clients related information, communications and presentations at key client meetings plus any client transport guides/information and other related documents, both electronic and published.
  • Lead on the planning, staffing and management of VIP and FIFA hotels operations including planning of all resources and the recruitment and training of transport desk staff.
  • Support delivery of Transport for all test events prior to the FWWC2027.
  • Work with Senior Transport Management team to prepare risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies for each client group.
  • Act as the primary transport liaison for assigned client groups, maintaining daily engagement and providing operational updates.
  • Monitor transport service performance (fleet allocation, on‑time performance, demand vs. capacity) and initiate real‑time adjustments as required.
  • Manage and resolve operational issues, delays, last‑minute schedule changes, and escalations affecting client transport services.
  • Oversee major peak movements, including arrivals, departures, and high‑profile competition or ceremony transport waves.
  • Provide daily reporting on service levels, incidents, and client feedback, ensuring transparency and continuous operational improvement.
  • Safeguard client satisfaction while ensuring services remain aligned with approved entitlements and operational constraints.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of event transport experience in international major events in at least two (2) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games/Expo. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands‑on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly‑owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
  • Deliver on‑demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
  • Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
  • Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
  • Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.

Qualifications and Experience

  • You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands‑on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
  • You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
  • You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
  • You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
  • You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
  • You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
  • You will also have strong problem‑solving and decision‑making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

Job Description

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide. As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development. You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design. Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To Succeed In This Role, You Typically Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom‑designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field—from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea. Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, You Will Find

  • A collaborative and international work environment.
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization.
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments.

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

Interested? If you are passionate about offshore engineering and eager to contribute to innovative subsea solutions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of a company dedicated to innovation, engineering excellence, and safety.

title: WHS Program Manager, WHS Implementation Management
description:
WHS Program Manager, WHS Implementation Management

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be best employer, and be safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the Amazon Workplace Health & Safety Brazil (BR WHS) is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as Program Manager for BR WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world‑class safety culture in the midst of Amazon's growth. In this role, responsibilities include diving deep into Operations processes; identifying risks through data and first‑hand experience; building and executing programs, and improving processes to eliminate risks; and influencing Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge the individual to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data‑driven decisions. In this role, cross‑functional work with members from various teams will be required, including Operations; Learning, ACEs, WHS, and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast‑paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have excellent judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

  • Development, review, approval, coordination, and leadership of large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs).
  • Relationships and partnerships across many organizations must be built to execute new initiatives and roadmaps each year.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders and partners to align on project and program goals and resources must be maintained.
  • A portfolio of programs and projects from inception to delivery must be coordinated. These may also be global in nature.
  • Metrics to measure and communicate Brazil program achievements must be defined and implemented.
  • Program decision support, insights, and recommendations through data gathering and information analysis must be provided.
  • Leadership of programs designed to standardize safety processes across business units must be demonstrated.
  • Business‑critical decisions that enable scalability and deliver industry‑leading performance must be influenced.
  • Processes must be benchmarked with Worldwide Workplace Health and Safety to continuously raise customer experience standards.
  • Program improvements and initiatives must be driven in close collaboration with Workplace Health and Safety business leaders and field and program teams.
  • New safety methods and processes across Brazil operations must be piloted.
  • Large‑scale, business‑critical problems through strategic projects and programs must be solved.

Basic Qualifications

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English.
  • Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting.
  • Experience leading and interacting with cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience managing medium to large‑scale projects.
  • Bachelor’s Degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a health and safety‑related subject.
  • Master's degree in Engineering or Business Administration or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement principles & techniques.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Maintenance Engineering Specialist-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
Job Overview

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

We are seeking a Maintenance Engineering Specialist to join Maintenance Solution Department (MSD) under Global Manufacturing Excellence.

MSD is responsible for providing specialized and timely maintenance engineering support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities.

The primary role is to provide technical expertise pertaining to the development, launching, and assessment of various maintenance programs, processes, procedures and best practices for Global Manufacturing facilities.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop maintenance processes, maintenance management strategy, work and performance management strategy and conduct Maintenance health assessment in line with GME and corporate requirements. This includes PM and PdM strategies, Organization structures, manpower analysis, cost analysis, etc., and appraise and prepare reports on the effectiveness of such processes.
  • Conduct data driven analyses to benchmark maintenance organization’s performance to identify gaps and set sustainable plan to close the gaps. This includes, but not limited to: Spending Analysis, Maintenance Effectiveness, operating costs of existing assets, PM, and PdM, Wrench time analysis, SAP Taxonomy, Planning & Scheduling, Personnel Competency, Budgeting Strategy, Bad Actors, and RAM Modeling.
  • Analyze facilities’ maintenance performance to establish reference baseline & issue frequent maintenance benchmarking reports to promote knowledge.
  • Review maintenance reporting mechanism and KPIs along with their trends to drive performance and provide recommendations accordingly.
  • Analyze maintenance spending in terms of manpower, equipment, materials procurement and outsource strategies.
  • Assist the line maintenance organizations in the implementation of approved programs such as TPRM or GM reliability model.
  • Develop methods and programs for handling new situations in maintenance fields. This will include prototype pumps, motors, compressors, turbines, valves, instrument systems and computer systems.
  • Design, in conjunction with engineering personnel and vendor representatives, alternative parts or systems.
  • Represent AMSD on standing Committees, Special Task Groups or Ad Hoc Committees.
  • Recommend work which can be economically assigned to contractor organizations and develops scope of work.

Qualifications

  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas downstream Sector.
  • You will be able to demonstrate high degree of technical competence in the area of maintenance programs and practices.
  • You will have experience with risk-based processes such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance & Risk Based Maintenance
  • You will have experience with TotalProductive Maintenance
  • You must have strong hands-on experience with Spare Parts and Materials procurement strategies
  • You will have Best-in-class Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Work Prioritization experience
  • You must have strong Experience with Maintenance budgeting and spending control methodologies.
  • You will have Experience in field maintenance methodologies, processes, and procedures.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with CMMS such as SAP

(Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting)

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior-level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Full stack or backend development
  • Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems
  • Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency
  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software.

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software, Systems, or Engineering disciplines, or Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features
  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • This job posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams.
  • Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs)
  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment.
  • Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process.

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

title: ANALISTA ADMINISTRATIVO -  CONTROLADORIA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar a gestão de documentos e arquivos, elaborar relatórios e planilhas para análise de dados, apoiar atividades administrativas e facilitar a comunicação entre departamentos. Contribuir para a implementação de políticas administrativas, atender demandas internas e externas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas ou Hospitalar ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos. Pós-graduação na área de atuação. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform — open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide — including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole — Kestra orchestrates mission‑critical workloads at scale. The open‑source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast‑growing global community. In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo – backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face.

The Role

We’re looking for a QA Engineer based in Brazil to ensure the quality and reliability of Kestra’s platform across both the open‑source and Enterprise editions. A key part of this role involves working directly with customer support tickets: understanding reported issues, reproducing them in local or staging environments, and verifying fixes before they ship. You’ll be the bridge between what customers experience and what the engineering team delivers. This is a fully remote position. We’re hiring from Brazil for timezone alignment with the broader team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and analyze customer support tickets to understand reported issues, extract reproduction steps, and translate customer‑reported problems into actionable bug reports for the engineering team.
  • Reproduce customer‑reported bugs across different environments and configurations, ensuring the engineering team has the context they need to fix issues efficiently.
  • Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases covering both the open‑source platform and Enterprise Edition features.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing for new features and regression testing for existing functionality across each release cycle.
  • Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and validate fixes before release.
  • Contribute to building and improving automated test coverage where applicable.
  • Track and report on quality metrics, test coverage, and recurring issue patterns to help the team prioritize improvements.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in software QA with a strong foundation in both manual and automated testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret customer support tickets, often with incomplete information, and systematically reproduce issues. This is central to the role.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and orchestration concepts: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow automation tools. You’ll need this context to test effectively.
  • Comfortable working with APIs, reading logs, and navigating distributed systems to trace issues.
  • Experience writing automated tests (for instance, in Java, Python, or TypeScript) and working with test frameworks.
  • Strong written communication in English. You’ll collaborate with a globally distributed team and document issues clearly.
  • Self‑directed and detail‑oriented. You can prioritize across incoming support issues and planned test cycles without heavy oversight.

Bonus Points

  • Past experience in a QA role that involved direct interaction with customer‑reported issues or support escalations.
  • Experience with open‑source software or B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with orchestration or workflow tools (Airflow, n8n, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of Java (Kestra’s core is written in Java).

What You Get

  • Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.
  • A product used for mission‑critical workloads — not demos.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance.

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations. Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Talent Acquisition, development & mobility
    • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
    • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
    • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
    • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Performance management & organizational development
    • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
    • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
    • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

These values are part of our DNA; they are the principles that guide everything that we do.

Role Purpose

As the Manager of Financial Statement Review, you will lead a team dedicated to review, optimization, and support of financial statement preparation for fund clients and ad-hoc structures. Your responsibilities include ensuring high standards of service delivery, compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP), and effective client management. This role emphasizes expertise in financial review, process improvement, technology utilization, cross-department collaboration, and innovation.

Responsibilities (high-level)

  • Operational Efficiency and Innovation:
  • Client Service and Support
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration

Your Daily Tasks

1. People Management Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

  • a) Team Management - Manage the company’s global technology and product teams and ensure that all team members have relevant Job Descriptions that include Tasks and KPIs.
  • b) Day-to-day Team management – Managing the team on a day-to-day basis by implementing:
  • Weekly task management
  • Weekly team meetings

c)Team Satisfaction - Monitoring the team's capacity and ensuring high-level satisfaction and work-life balance.

d) Feedback and Coaching - Providing feedback and coaching to the team members with the aim of constantly improving their performance.

e) Team Training - Coordinating and providing training and development programs within the technology and product teams as or when required.

f) Team Succession planning - Identifying any high-potential and high-risk employees and developing the relevant succession plans.

2. Financial Statement Review and Oversight:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Review and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of financial statements prepared by the Financial Preparation team, ensuring accuracy, compliance with accounting standards, and high-quality presentation.

b) Process Accountability: Take ownership of the financial statement review cycle and be accountable for adherence to deadlines, service levels, and client expectations.

c) Complex Structures: Support and review the preparation of statements for complex fund structures, addressing intricate financial and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Development and Technology Optimization:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Process Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance financial statement processes through automation and system integration, minimizing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency.

b) System Utilization: Collaborate with technology and operations teams to optimize existing systems and identify new tools to streamline data transformation for financial statements.

c) Innovation Implementation: Drive the adoption of scalable processes, leveraging technology and best practices to ensure compliance and efficiency.

4. Operational Efficiency and Innovation:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Workflow Enhancement: Develop, implement, and refine workflows to support seamless financial statement review and improve productivity.

b) Scalability Focus: Identify opportunities to expand and scale financial statement support services to meet client needs and market demands.

c)New Solutions: Collaborate with product teams to design and introduce new services tailored to changing client needs and market conditions.

5. Client Service and Support:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the main point of contact for clients utilizing the Financial Statement Review Service, addressing their needs with professionalism and insight.

b) Client Engagement: Build and maintain client relationships, proactively managing expectations, service requests, and bespoke solutions.

c) Industry Adaptation: Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging practices to continuously adapt and enhance service offerings.

6. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

  • Work cross-functionally with operations, business users, and project teams to deliver comprehensive and innovative solutions.
  • Drive process integration across service lines to ensure consistent, high-quality client service delivery and effective resource utilization.

7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory requirements, and jurisdictional changes affecting entities reporting under IFRS or US GAAP.

b) Act as the primary contact for all client interactions with external auditors, ensuring comprehensive, accurate, and timely responses.

c) Support new fund onboarding by ensuring smooth integration into financial statement workflows and compliance standards.

d) Policy Implementation: Help implement compliance policies at the operational level.

e) Monitoring Tools: Utilize tools to monitor compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

f) Compliance Culture - Working in tandem with the groups Head of Compliance and Governance to instill a culture that is centered around good governance and compliance.

g) Reporting: Assist in preparing compliance reports for management review.

h) Issue Tracking: Track and manage compliance-related issues and follow up on resolutions.

i) Communication: Communicate compliance requirements effectively within the team.

Strategic Expectations

  • Share insights to enable development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.
  • Maintain awareness of industry, regulatory, jurisdictional, and other trends that could affect the business.
  • Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuous changing needs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you getting excited? We are! Before we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you’ll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

  • Internationally recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, ACCA, CA).
  • Minimum 7 years’ post-qualification experience with a Big 4 accounting firm.
  • Experience in auditing or preparing financial statements for investment-related entities under US-GAAP and IFRS.
  • 5 years Fund accounting experience working with both Private Equity Funds and Hedge Funds.
  • Experience and knowledge of the digital accounting Funds space is preferable.
  • Knowledge of fund accounting software and expert use of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Power Query, Power Automate).
  • Proven track record of managing financial statement preparation teams and improving process efficiencies.
  • Familiarity with complex financial instruments and investment funds.
  • Experience serving a LATAM and US client base, particularly Brazilian clients.
  • CFA/CA designation completed or a willingness to complete.
  • Expertise with Geneva, Dynamo, Mantra, and other portfolio accounting systems.

Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;
  • Pós Graduação e/ou Especialização na area de reabilitação.

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos:Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito deoferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

  • Ser o elo estratégico entre Trade Marketing e a Diretoria Comercial, garantindo alinhamento, priorização e execução das iniciativas;
  • Desdobrar e implementar planos de Trade alinhados à estratégia comercial, adaptando-os às necessidades e oportunidades;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças comerciais, influenciando decisões, identificando oportunidades e impulsionando resultados através de um planejamento estratégico de Trade consistente para o ano;

  • Monitorar e analisar performance de todas as ações, identificando desvios e propondo otimizações com visão crítica e orientada a dados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de novos negócios na cia, contribuindo com visão de mercado, construção de propostas de valor e go-to-market.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo nos cursos de Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
